scientific_integrity: The theorem and its sharpness rest on a self-contained analytic dyadic induction and explicit extremizers; enumerations are supplementary. Bibliographic originality is based on specified material inspections and does not imply exhaustive novelty certification.
scientific_limitations: Binary dyadic filtration only; no uniqueness or nonbinary extension. Closely related 2014 maximal-observable sharp threshold and constant are prior art, not claimed new. A 1996 ordinary-BLO article was accessible only as an abstract; equivalent dyadic refinements remain a residual literature risk.
title: Exact mean-sensitive exponential Bellman function for dyadic lower oscillation
